description: Header file for STM32F4 series FLASH RAM functions, defining external functions for flash interface control and sleep modes, with include guards and conditional compilation for specific STM32F4 variants.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_StopFlashInterfaceClk
methods.description: Function to stop the flash interface clock, stored in RAM.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_StartFlashInterfaceClk
methods.description: Function to start the flash interface clock, stored in RAM.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_EnableFlashSleepMode
methods.description: Function to enable flash sleep mode, stored in RAM.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_DisableFlashSleepMode
methods.description: Function to disable flash sleep mode, stored in RAM.
